name: AtlTooltip
purpose: Hover- and focus-triggered label that names or briefly explains the element it is attached to. Appears on a delay, disappears when the pointer or focus moves away, and never takes focus itself.

rules.statement: Naming an icon-only button or control so it reads correctly to assistive tech and on hover.
Annotating an abbreviation, truncated label, or terse column header with its full form.
Adding a short keyboard-shortcut hint to a button or menu item.
Explaining why a disabled control is disabled, without committing to a popover.
Holding rich content, links, or interactive controls inside the tip.
rules.useInstead: A popover or dialog — tooltips are non-interactive label text only.

rules.statement: Communicating critical information that the user must read to complete a task.
rules.useInstead: AtlAlert, inline help text, or visible labels — tooltips disappear on blur and are skipped on touch.

rules.statement: Acting as the only accessible name for an interactive element.
rules.useInstead: A proper `aria-label` or visible label — pair the tooltip with that label rather than relying on it alone.

notes: Uses aria-describedby — the tooltip supplements, never replaces, the trigger's accessible name.
The tooltip is not focusable itself — the host element owns the tab stop.
Tooltips are shown on focus, not only on hover, so keyboard users get the same affordance.
Never put interactive content (links, buttons) inside a tooltip — it cannot be reached by keyboard.

mismatches.name: atlTooltipDisabled
mismatches.reason: Not modelled as a Boolean (ADR-0056): renders nothing. atl-tooltip.tsx early-returns on it, so there is no disabled tooltip to draw — only the absence of one.

mismatches.name: position
mismatches.reason: The axis is named after the spec union AtlTooltipPosition, the way every other master derives its axis name from its union — not after the Angular directive-input field name. A prior rename to 'atlTooltipPosition' was corrected back to 'position' (ADR-0056); the code prop itself stays atlTooltipPosition. Settled difference (ADR-0145), behaviour not drawing: only Angular flips a clipped tooltip to the opposite side (CDK flexible overlay positions with a fallback and withPush); React and Vue apply position as a fixed CSS class and do not flip, deliberately. Figma draws one position per variant and has no clipped state.

tokens.name: --ui-color-surface
tokens.intent: Base page background. The canvas every other surface elevates from.
constraints: Pair with --ui-color-text or --ui-color-text-muted only — never raw black/white.
Do not stack two surfaces of the same level on top of each other — use -raised or -sunken.

tokens.name: --ui-color-text
tokens.intent: Primary body and heading text colour. Use on --ui-color-surface and its raised/sunken variants.
constraints: Must meet >=4.5:1 contrast against the surface it renders on (verified for all --ui-color-surface* pairs).
Do not use as a fill colour — this is a foreground token.

tokens.name: --ui-duration-fast
tokens.intent: Short transition (150ms). Use for hover/focus state changes and micro-interactions.
constraints: Respects prefers-reduced-motion via the @media block — do not override durations elsewhere.
Do not interpolate between scale steps; pick the nearest defined value.

tokens.name: --ui-ease-out
tokens.intent: Decelerating easing curve. Use for entrances and elements arriving on screen.
constraints: Use --ui-ease-out for entrances, --ui-ease-in-out for movement, --ui-ease-spring for emphasised transitions.

tokens.name: --ui-font-family
tokens.intent: Default UI typeface stack. Instrument Sans first, with system fallbacks for offline / first-paint (ADR-0035).
constraints: Declare it once on each component root — not per rule, and not left to the app shell: a component that depends on the consumer applying it renders in the app's font while its neighbours render this one (measured; ADR-0049).
Use --ui-font-display for the one display line per surface; everything interactive stays on this stack.

tokens.name: --ui-font-size-xs
tokens.intent: Smallest readable size (0.75rem). Use for badges, captions, table meta, and dense labels.
constraints: Do not use for body copy or interactive labels users must read at a glance.

tokens.name: --ui-line-height-normal
tokens.intent: Default leading (1.5) for body copy and multi-line UI text.
constraints: This is the implicit baseline — only set explicitly when overriding a parent.

tokens.name: --ui-radius-sm
tokens.intent: Small rounding (0.5rem) for compact controls — badges, tags, inline chips.
constraints: Do not interpolate between scale steps; pick the nearest defined value.

tokens.name: --ui-shadow-md
tokens.intent: Default elevation for raised surfaces (cards, dropdowns at rest).
constraints: Combine with a 1px subtle border for clarity on busy backgrounds.
Avoid stacking with --ui-shadow-lg on the same surface.

tokens.name: --ui-spacing-1
tokens.intent: Hairline spacing (0.25rem). Use for icon-to-label gaps and tightest groupings.
constraints: Do not interpolate between scale steps; pick the nearest defined value.

tokens.name: --ui-spacing-2
tokens.intent: Tight spacing (0.5rem). Use for compact button padding and dense list rows.
constraints: Do not interpolate between scale steps; pick the nearest defined value.

tokens.name: --ui-z-dropdown
tokens.intent: Stacking level for popovers, dropdowns, and menus that float above page content.
constraints: Layer ordering: base < dropdown < overlay < modal < toast. Do not exceed the scale; if you need more, restructure.
